newsitem.title: USA: AirTouch may need to change U S West terms.
newsitem.headline: AirTouch may need to change U S West terms.

text.p: AirTouch Communications said it may need to renegotiate its $5 billion purchase of the wireless business of U S West Communications Group's US West Media Group if the deal is taxable.
Earlier, a senior congressional aide said the deal would be taxable under a tax bill agreed between the White House and congressional leaders.

In April, AirTouch and U S West announced the deal, which had the same strategic objective of an earlier pact in 1994, but would close more quickly and was conditioned upon getting tax relief by using "Morris Trust" tax-free provisions.
"We said if we were not able to be grandfathered under the 'Morris Trust', we can revert back to the 1994 deal or choose to renegotiate with U S West," the aide said.
The sweeping reform, which aims to cut taxes by $94 billion over the next five years by restricting tax relief to companies using the popular technique in mergers and acquisitions.

The aide was speaking at a briefing on the tax bill agreed on Monday between Republican leaders in Congress and the White House. "We've heard the same thing, but we haven't confirmed that its entirely over yet," she said.
